Heading 7324 covers sanitary fixtures for hygiene (washing, bathing, waste disposal), not movable storage caddies.

N359804.reason: The IndeeLift PPU-S is a self-contained, battery-powered lifting device with a vertical post, actuator assembly, and a seat/platform that lowers to the floor to raise a person up to 30 inches. It is not a passenger/freight elevator (8428.10), pneumatic elevator/conveyor (8428.20), continuous-action goods conveyor (8428.3x), escalator/moving walkway (8428.40), teleferic/chair lift (8428.60), or industrial robot (8428.70). At the subheading level 8428.90.03 'Other machinery,' it is not woodland log handling equipment (8428.90.03.10). Therefore it falls under the residual statistical suffix 8428.90.03.90 'Other.'

N359300.reason: The product contains clozapine, an atypical antipsychotic. The proposed line 3004.90.92.35 is specifically for medicaments containing tramadol. Clozapine is not tramadol, so this line does not apply. At Level 6, clozapine is not listed among the named subheadings (tolmetin, ibuprofen, acetaminophen, aspirin, tramadol); it falls under the residual 'Other' line 3004.90.92.36.

N361386.reason: The product is a costume (flimsy robe), which is a festive/entertainment article. It is not a Christmas article (9505.10), a magic trick/practical joke article (9505.90.20), or confetti/paper spirals/streamers/party favors/noisemakers (9505.90.40). The unfinished edges and simple stitching do not affect classification at this level. It falls under the residual subheading 9505.90.60.00.

N358898.reason: The harness is a wiring set of a kind used in vehicles (commercial vehicles) with multiple coaxial conductors fitted with connectors, which falls under heading 8544.30 (Ignition wiring sets and other wiring sets of a kind used in vehicles, aircraft or ships) rather than 8544.42.

N360179.reason: The tracing projector is a compact plastic device that projects images from interchangeable disks onto paper for children to trace. It is an image projector, not a cinematographic projector, slide projector, microform reader, or photographic enlarger/reducer. Therefore, it falls under 9008.50.40.00 (Other image projectors).

N361291.reason: The product is a tanker trailer designed to transport propane (a liquid/gas), which falls specifically under 8716.31.00.00 'Tanker trailers and tanker semi-trailers.' The proposed path incorrectly places it under the residual 8716.39 'Other' category.

N358304.reason: The speaker module incorporates two speakers in a single enclosure, making it 'Multiple loudspeakers, mounted in the same enclosure' under 8518.22.00.00, not 'Single loudspeakers' under 8518.21.00.00.

N356812.reason: The product is an electrothermic appliance of a kind used for domestic purposes (electric skillet/griddle). It falls under 8516.60 (other ovens; cooking stoves, ranges, cooking plates, boiling rings, grillers and roasters). It is not a cooking stove, range, or oven (8516.60.40), so it is correctly classified under the residual 8516.60.60.00. Prior rulings (N261921, N118555, N130979, N151555, N179422) confirm this classification for similar electric skillets/griddles.

N360406.reason: The temperature control assembly is an integral part of the engine's cooling system, regulating coolant flow to the radiator and heater via a thermostatic wax element. This function is essential to the engine's operation and power train, making it a part for power trains under 8708.99.68 rather than a residual 'Other' part under 8708.99.81.

N361312.reason: The product is a costume (vest), which is a festive/entertainment article. It is not a Christmas article (9505.10), a magic trick/practical joke article (9505.90.20), or confetti/paper spirals/streamers/party favors/noisemakers (9505.90.40). The raw, unfinished armholes and non-functional buttons do not affect classification at this level. It falls under the residual subheading 9505.90.60.00.

N359447.reason: The proposed line 3004.90.92.20 is specifically for cardiovascular medicaments containing amiodarone or its salts. The product contains riociguat, a guanylate cyclase stimulator, which is not amiodarone. Riociguat is not listed among the named active ingredients in any of the alternative Level 5 lines (metoprolol, diltiazem, hydralazine, enoxaparin, labetalol, or the group in 3004.90.92.25). Therefore, the product falls under the residual 'Other' line 3004.90.92.26.

N359594.reason: The vehicle has a 5,344 cc engine, which exceeds the 3,000 cc upper limit for subheading 8703.23.01. The correct subheading for a cylinder capacity exceeding 3,000 cc is 8703.24.01.

N361157.reason: The imported merchandise consists of complete vessel fin stabilizer systems (HS, LR, LRSTAB) and a vessel steering system (DIRECTA). These are integrated electromechanical systems whose primary function is the physical control of a vessel's motion (roll, pitch, yaw, steering) through actuators, fins, motors, inertial platforms, and control units. Heading 8537 covers bases (boards, panels, consoles, cabinets) equipped with two or more apparatus of heading 8535 or 8536 for electric control or distribution of electricity. The stabilizer and steering systems are not merely equipped bases for electrical control/distribution; they are complete machinery systems for vessel motion control. The individual control panels (Electronic Control Unit, Electronic Power Unit, Wheelhouse Control Station) may fall in 8537 when imported separately, but the complete systems as described are excluded from 8537 and belong in headings such as 8483 (transmission/gearing), 8481 (hydraulic/pneumatic actuators), 9014/9032 (navigation/automatic control), or 8908 (vessel equipment).

N359913.reason: The proposed line 3004.90.92.21 is specifically for cardiovascular medicaments containing diltiazem or its salts. The product contains olmesartan medoxomil, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which is not diltiazem. Olmesartan medoxomil is not listed among the named active ingredients in any of the alternative Level 5 lines (metoprolol, amiodarone, hydralazine, enoxaparin, labetalol, or the group in 3004.90.92.25). Therefore, the product falls under the residual 'Other' line 3004.90.92.26.

N358307.reason: The product is a tissue-paper wipe (paper) impregnated with a cleaning solution containing a surfactant (detergent). This matches the explicit language of heading 3401 covering 'paper, wadding, felt and nonwovens, impregnated, coated or covered with soap or detergent' and the residual subheading 3401.19.00 for all such articles other than those for toilet use. Precedent rulings N309230 and N321568 confirm classification under 3401.19.0000 for essentially identical lens-cleaning paper wipes. The product is not for toilet use, so 3401.11 does not apply, and it is not a soap bar/cake or a skin-washing liquid/cream, so the other level-1 alternatives do not apply.

N360804.reason: The product is a headphone assembly consisting of two ear cup speakers with integrated microphones, a cable harness, and a wired control box module, all imported together as a complete retrofit kit for aviation helmets. This constitutes 'headphones and earphones, whether or not combined with a microphone' under heading 8518.30. It is not a line telephone handset (8518.30.10), so it falls under the 'Other' subheading 8518.30.20.00.

N358156.reason: Each imported SKU is a retail set of a candle and a separate steel stand/holder. GRI 3(b) gives essential character to the candle, but the set as a whole is not a 'candle, taper or the like' and should be classified as a set under GRI 3(c) (likely in heading 8306).

N358387.reason: The foldable hand fan is a made-up textile article not specifically provided for elsewhere in the tariff schedule. It falls under heading 6307 as 'Other made up articles'. It is not a cleaning cloth (6307.10), lifejacket (6307.20), needlecraft set, label (6307.90.30), cord/tassel (6307.90.40), lacing (6307.90.50), surgical drape, pet toy (6307.90.75), or man-made fiber wall banner (6307.90.85). At the 6307.90.98 level, it is not a surgical towel, cotton pile/tufted towel, pillow shell, or quilt shell (6307.90.89), nor a national flag, face mask, cotton towel (6307.90.98.82), man-made fiber towel (6307.90.98.84), or furniture mover's pad (6307.90.98.85/87). The residual 'Other' (6307.90.98.91) is therefore correct.

N357223.reason: The Titan Pro Ice Pack Set is a composite article consisting of a gel sealed inside a multi-layer nylon/aluminum/mylar pouch, not a bulk chemical preparation classifiable under heading 3824. The essential character of the product is that of a refrigerating pack (a manufactured article), so it falls outside Chapter 38.

N357206.reason: The product consists of industrial silicone-based sealing compounds (Loctite 5900 and 5910) designed for engine flange sealing and industrial machinery gasketing. They are non-corrosive, flexible, oil-resistant compounds used in MRO operations. At Level 0, heading 3214 covers 'caulking compounds and other mastics.' At Level 1, subheading 3214.10.00 covers 'caulking compounds and other mastics; painters' fillings,' which is the correct provision as opposed to 3214.90 (Other). At Level 2, the products are mastics (mastic-type sealing compounds), not painters' fillings. At Level 3, the statistical reporting number 3214.10.00.20 ('Other') correctly captures mastics other than caulking compounds (3214.10.00.10). The product fits the full path.

N357964.reason: The product is a dynamometer test system — an assembled apparatus comprising two permanent-magnet motors, gearboxes, torque transducers, controllers, power supply, cooling fans, safety cover, and mounting hardware — designed to simulate riding loads on e-bike mid-drive units. Heading 8501 covers electric motors and generators as individual machines; it does not cover complex testing systems that incorporate motors as sub-components.

N359763.reason: The product captures video images and transmits them to a connected gateway for processing and recording, and explicitly cannot record images. Therefore, it is a television camera (video camera) rather than a video camera recorder. Subheading 8525.89.40.00 is limited to digital still image video cameras, which are a type of video camera recorder. The product belongs under the alternative 'Television cameras' within 8525.89.

N359807.reason: The gaming PCs are automatic data processing machines comprising in the same housing at least a central processing unit and an input and output unit (via USB, HDMI, etc.), making them classifiable under 8471.41.01. They are not portable machines (8471.30) as they are traditional desktop PCs, and they are not 'Other, entered in the form of systems' (8471.49) as each is a single integrated unit. The 8-digit subheading 8471.41.01 covers both CRT and non-CRT types; since these are modern desktops without CRT, the statistical suffix .50 'Other' applies.

N359472.reason: The product is a stainless steel housing for an in-roadway pedestrian crosswalk warning light (LightStar™ Plus with SMPL™). At Level 1, it is a part of a luminaire/lighting fitting (the complete warning light unit), not a complete luminaire itself, so it falls under 'Parts' (9405.99). At Level 2, it is 'Other' (9405.99) because it is of stainless steel, not glass (9405.91) or plastics (9405.92). At Level 3, it is 'Other' (9405.99.40) because it is not of brass (9405.99.20). At Level 4, the statistical suffixes cover lampposts/bases of cast iron (.10) and aluminum (.20); a stainless steel housing for an in-roadway marker is neither, so it falls under the residual 'Other' (.90).

N358088.reason: The product is a pet costume made of 100% polyester with foam lining, which is neither a dog leash, collar, muzzle, harness, nor similar dog equipment. It therefore falls outside 4201.00.30.00 and within the residual 'Other' subheading 4201.00.60.00.

H321679.reason: The product description identifies the items as 'hamper tote bags' but does not state their intended use. Classification under 'Travel, sports and similar bags' requires that the bags be of a kind normally used for travel, sports, or similar activities. Without knowing the principal use, it cannot be confirmed that they fall within this subheading rather than 'Insulated food or beverage bags', 'Musical instrument cases', or the residual 'Other' category at this level.

N359532.reason: The 2-piece set consists of a foot-pedal trash can (body, lid, pedal of powder-coated iron sheet metal; inner bucket and base of PP) and a toilet brush with holder. Neither article is sanitary ware (baths, wash-basins, sinks, bidets, lavatory pans, flushing cisterns, urinals, or similar fixed installations) nor a part thereof; both are freestanding household articles of iron or steel and plastics. The set is therefore excluded from heading 7324 and would fall under heading 7323 (table, kitchen or other household articles and parts thereof, of iron or steel) or heading 3924 (household articles of plastics) under GRI 3(b) depending on essential character.

N358235.reason: Athletic groin protectors (protective cups) are sports protective equipment used across multiple sports (e.g., baseball, hockey, football, lacrosse, martial arts) and are not limited to a single named sport. They are not 'articles and equipment for general physical exercise, gymnastics or athletics' (9506.91) because they are protective gear, not exercise equipment. They do not fall under any of the named sport-specific subheadings at Level 3 (archery, badminton, baseball, football/soccer/polo, ice-hockey/field-hockey, lacrosse sticks, lawn-tennis, skeet, sleds, snowshoes, swimming pools) because they are not dedicated to one of those sports. The product therefore falls under the residual 'Other' at Level 3 (9506.99.60) and, at Level 4, is not a net, so it is classified under 9506.99.60.80 Other.

N359501.reason: Both the CISC RFID Xplorer and the CISC RAIN Xplorer Inline 100 are instruments that measure and evaluate UHF RFID performance parameters (tag sensitivity, backscatter power, radiation patterns, conformance metrics, read/write/encode verification). They are not balancing machines (9031.10), test benches (9031.20), optical instruments (9031.40), electron-beam microscopes for semiconductor handling (9031.80.40), or equipment for testing internal combustion engines (the 9031.80.80 breakout for engine-testing equipment). Their essential character is that of measuring/checking instruments not specified elsewhere in Chapter 90, so they fall within the residual 9031.80.80.85 provision.

N358745.reason: The product is an adult-size 'Elven Archer' costume consisting of a tunic, pants, belt with shoulder strap, hooded shoulder cape, gauntlets, and artificial elf ears. This is a festive/entertainment costume for occasions such as Halloween, masquerade, or theatrical use. It is not a Christmas article (9505.10), a magic trick or practical joke article (9505.90.20), nor confetti, paper spirals, streamers, party favors, or noisemakers (9505.90.40). Therefore, it falls under the residual subheading 9505.90.60.00.

N358452.reason: The product is a radiobroadcast receiver (AM/FM) not capable of operating without an external power source, of a kind used in motor vehicles (Level 1). It is combined with sound reproducing apparatus via USB playback and Bluetooth audio streaming (Level 2). It is not a radio-tape player combination (Level 3). It does not incorporate optical disc players or recorders (Level 5 alternative). It is not capable of receiving and decoding digital radio data system signals (Level 4 alternative). Therefore, it falls under the residual 8527.21.25.25.

N358306.reason: The RIC2Discover System is a complete cattle feeding and watering system that provides feed and water to cattle while recording individual animal intake via RFID and weighing technology. This constitutes 'Other agricultural... machinery' under heading 8436. It is not machinery for preparing animal feeds (8436.10), poultry-keeping machinery, or parts. At the statistical suffix level, it is not forestry machinery (.20), barn and barnyard machines (.40), machines for preparing crops for market (.60), or bee-keeping machinery (.70). As livestock (cattle) feeding and watering equipment with integrated data recording for research and commercial farms, it falls under the residual 'Other' category 8436.80.00.90.

N359915.reason: The product contains olanzapine, an atypical antipsychotic. Furthermore, olanzapine is an antipsychotic, not an analgesic/antipyretic/NSAID. The correct Level 5 classification would be 'Antidepressants, tranquilizers, and other psychotherapeutic agents', and at Level 6 it would fall under 3004.90.92.36 (Other).

N359976.reason: The Xumo Stream Box is a reception apparatus for television that receives streaming content via the Internet and outputs it to a TV via HDMI. It is a set top box with a communications function (network connectivity for Internet streaming), which matches 8528.71.20.00. The lack of a tuner does not exclude it from this heading, as heading 8528 covers reception apparatus 'whether or not incorporating television reception apparatus.'

N361275.reason: The product is a 'ductile fitting' (ductile iron), which is expressly covered by 7307.19.30 'Ductile fittings' at Level 3. The proposed line 7307.19.90.60 is a sibling under 'Other' and therefore does not apply.
